Marcus Overholt

body:
Well hello. Owner of Hartsell Hardware here, and I am not in a good mood. The replacement drive parts you sent for my FH-520 stump grinders came in with the housing split right down the side. This is the second box in a row that got here broken. I've got a customer waiting and I've been waiting on you for two weeks. Bill Hartsell
Hartsell Hardware

body:
To Whom It May Concern:

On Tuesday, a freight carrier delivered a pallet of portable generators, model FH-G7, to our store. The driver departed before we could inspect the units, and the delivery receipt was not signed by our staff. Upon unwrapping the pallet, we found visible crush damage to the frames of at least two units. We wish to document the damage and understand how to proceed with a freight claim. Photographs are available upon request. Please advise on the correct procedure.

Sincerely,
Helen Marchetti
Owner, Marchetti Hardware & Supply

body:
need help asap. we are a dealer and keep getting FH-340 chippers back from customers, same thing every time, the drive belt shreds within a few weeks of use. its up to 5 units now since august. i cant keep eating the labor on these. who do i talk to about this and do we send them back or what. need to get this settled before month end close.

Gary Voss, A/P, Tri-County Outdoor Power

Hello,

Best regards,
Owen Ellery
Service Manager, Ellery Equipment

subject: FH-520 welds

subject: Safety reports concerning FH-P90 pressure washers
body:
Dear Fernhollow Customer Relations,

I am the operations manager at Greenbough Landscape Services, and I am writing on behalf of ourselves and several of our retail customers, to whom we have supplied your FH-P90 pressure washers over the past year. In the last six weeks we have received four separate reports of the high-pressure hose bursting at the pump end during normal operation. In one case an employee suffered a minor hand injury. We have stopped lending out the remaining units from our stock and have segregated them in our warehouse.

We require a formal response regarding whether this is a known issue, whether a recall or inspection program exists, and what you recommend we tell the affected customers. Our purchase records reference orders FE-112240 and FE-113006. Please respond in writing at your earliest convenience, as we have a duty to our customers.

Respectfully,
Elaine Whitcombe
Operations Manager, Greenbough Landscape Services

subject: Wedge trouble on the 340s!
body:
Hey Fernhollow crew! Ned here from Ned's Hardware & Garden, been selling your stuff for a few years now and generally love it. But I unboxed the shipment of FH-340 chippers yesterday and holy moly, three out of the five have a bad weld right where the hopper bolts on, and I think one has the wrong size bolts in the kit (they just don't thread into the frame). I took photos, they look pretty rough. I don't want to put these on my floor, my regulars would notice in a second. What's the best way to handle this? Do I send them back, or can you ship me the right bolts and a repair guy? Whatever's easiest on your end works for me too. Appreciate you!

Ned Okafor
Owner, Ned's Hardware & Garden

subject: Reported hose failures, FH-P90

body:
Ok so the freight guy dropped a pallet of FH-210 log splitters at our store at 4:45 on a Thursday, didn't wait for us to look, and had me sign a tablet thing I couldn't even read. Now I've got a bent beam on one splitter and a smashed engine guard on another. Who pays for this? I'm not eating it. I'm a small store, I can't absorb two ruined units. Tell me what I need to do, and fast.

Frank Dobbins, Dobbins Farm & Feed

body:
This is the second time. We ordered cutter wheel teeth and a pivot kit for the FH-520 and what showed up was a set of belts that don't fit anything we own. My crews are down a stump grinder because of this and we have jobs scheduled Monday. I've spent more time on the phone about this than the part is worth. Please just send the right parts and tell me how to return the wrong ones. Order FE-118802.

Rosa Delgado, Ops Manager, Delgado Land & Tree

body:

I'd appreciate some guidance on whether this is a known problem and how you would like me to handle the returns. I want to keep my customers happy, but I also need to know where I stand. Walt Henderson
Henderson Farm Supply

subject: Another batch of stump grinders back
body:
Hi,

Another customer brought a stump grinder back to my store today, which makes the fourth from your FH-520 line since September. Two had a bearing at the cutter wheel that seized up, one chewed through its drive belt, and one just developed a grinding noise that the customer says started out of the box. I try not to complain, because most of what I carry from you sells nicely. But I have a small shop, and my techs are spending hours on warranty-type repairs I am not sure I should be doing for free. I have kept the failed bearings in a box. Can someone reach out about what you would like me to do with these, and whether there is a pattern you are seeing from other dealers? Our account is under Teague Farm & Fleet Supply. Thank you.

Lorraine Teague
Owner, Teague Farm & Fleet Supply

Dear Sir or Madam,

We ordered a replacement recoil starter assembly for a portable generator that we sell. The part that arrived was designed for a different engine, and the mounting holes do not align. We would like to return it and receive the correct component. Kindly provide a return authorization and instructions for shipment at your earliest convenience.

Sincerely,
Gregory Aldous
Parts Department, Aldous & Sons Outdoor Equipment

body:
Dear Fernhollow Equipment Supply,

I am writing on behalf of Highland Rental Partners regarding our recent purchase order for FH-520 stump grinders. The packing list included with the shipment enumerates ten units. Upon receipt and inspection, however, we counted only seven FH-520 units, and two additional machines of a different model that we did not order. We have retained all packaging and the bill of lading. We respectfully request that you investigate the discrepancy, ship the three missing units or issue a corrected invoice, and collect the machines that were sent in error. Please let us know what documentation you require from our side. We would appreciate a response within three business days, as our spring fleet schedule depends on these machines.

Yours faithfully,
Nadia Kaczmarek
Fleet Manager, Highland Rental Partners

Ugh. Three FH-210 from the same pallet with wrong bolts on the wedge. Third time this year. Please fix this.

When we opened the shrink wrap, three of the units had dented frames and one had a snapped fitting on the pump. We would like to file a damage claim and ask what documentation you need.

Hey there, hope your week is going well! Quick one. We've been sending splitters out to a few of the smaller shops around here, and two of them told me their FH-210 started leaking fluid from the hose and one said it got scary hot to the touch near the pump. Nobody hurt, thank goodness, but I figured you'd want to know. Wondering if anyone else has reported it and whether there's something we should be telling customers? Thanks!

Todd Brannigan, Ops Manager, Brannigan Land Care

body:
Good morning,

I wanted to let you know that I've had several customers return their FH-340 wood chippers over the last couple of months. The most common issue is that the belt starts slipping and then fails, and on two units the bearings in the flywheel have gone noisy. I would appreciate it if someone could look into this and let me know how to handle the returns and exchanges for my store. Thank you for your attention.

Wilma Koenig
Koenig's Farm Supply

subject: Request for credit or return authorization - FH-520
body:
Dear Accounts Team,

We are Redwater Equipment Rentals and we currently hold four FH-520 stump grinders in inventory that we have determined to be defective. Specifically, the cutter wheel bearings on each unit show excessive play, and two of the machines exhibit belt squeal under light load. These units have not been put into service. We understand that a return merchandise process may exist, and we would like to formally request either a credit against our account or collection of the machines by your freight carrier. Our most recent related invoice is FE-120377. Please send us whatever forms and photographs you require, along with an estimate of how long the process takes. We have several rental commitments pending and would like to resolve this efficiently.

Thank you for your assistance.

Sincerely,
Jonathan Freel
Fleet Manager, Redwater Equipment Rentals

body:
Hi! Parts guy at Oakdale Outdoor here. Our FH-210 pallet showed up yesterday afternoon and the driver was out the door before I'd even cut the wrap. Now I'm looking at a bent wedge and a hose that's been crushed on two of the units, and of course the paperwork was already signed by whoever was on the dock. Not the end of the world but I'd love to know how to start a damage claim with you. Photos are ready to go. Cheers!

Ray Castellano, Oakdale Outdoor Equipment

subject: Bad batch of FH-340
body:
Good afternoon,

This has been a strange month at Whitlow Grounds & Gardens. We started the season with a crew shortage, and then our truck needed a new transmission, which set us back a good ten days. My brother-in-law has been helping on weekends, and he keeps joking that we should have gone into accounting. Anyway, the spring cleanup contracts for the three apartment complexes are finally back on track, which is a relief, since we nearly lost the largest one. We have been loyal buyers of your equipment for years and we resell a few units to the smaller outfits that work with us.

On to the actual point of my message. We received a shipment of FH-340 chippers last week and four of the six have cracked welds along the feed hopper, and a couple more have bolts that do not seem to match the frame. I would like to know how to report this properly and how you would like us to handle those units. I have photos. Please let me know who to send them to. Thanks again for your patience with a rambling email!

Warm regards,
Derek Whitlow
Operations Manager, Whitlow Grounds & Gardens

subject: Damaged replacement parts for the 340
body:
Good morning,

I hope this finds you well. I am writing from Alder Creek Distribution, where I have been buying for the outdoor equipment line for about six years. First, thank you for the quick turnaround last quarter on our other orders. Our warehouse expansion finished in September, and we now have much more room for inventory, which has been wonderful. We also hired two new forklift operators, and they have been settling in nicely, although the learning curve with our new scanning system has been steep. My colleague jokes that half of my job is just translating between the warehouse and the office.

I do have one issue to raise. The replacement parts you sent for our FH-340 chipper units, order FE-121490, arrived with the knife holder bracket snapped in two and the feed roller kit was the wrong version. We would like to return these and get the correct, intact parts shipped. Please let me know the procedure. I can send photos if that helps.

Many thanks and best regards,
Isabel Grantham
Buyer, Alder Creek Distribution

body:
Good morning,

I work in accounts payable for Stonebridge Outdoor Power and I am trying to reconcile an invoice against what physically arrived. The invoice and the packing list both show twelve FH-520 stump grinders. Our receiving team counted nine FH-520 units, plus a pallet of three machines that appear to be a different model altogether. We are being asked to pay the full amount, but I am not able to approve payment until we know what is going on. Could someone from your fulfillment team look into this and send a corrected invoice or confirmation of a follow-up shipment? I am happy to forward our receiving report. Thank you in advance for your help.

Kind regards,
Margaret Oyelaran
Accounts Payable, Stonebridge Outdoor Power

subject: 340 pallet damage
body:
Howdy! We got our pallet of FH-340 chippers in and the driver didn't hang around for us to check them. Two have bent hoppers, one has a busted guard. Nobody signed for anything as far as I know since I was out on the lot. Can you point me to who handles freight damage? Thanks, appreciate y'all.

Buck Tolliver, Tolliver Farm & Ranch Supply

subject: Devoluciones repetidas de trituradoras de tocones FH-520
body:
Estimados señores de Fernhollow:

Les escribo desde Alquileres Sierra Verde. Somos una empresa de alquiler de maquinaria y también revendemos algunas unidades a clientes pequeños. Durante los últimos dos meses, varios de esos clientes nos han devuelto sus trituradoras de tocones FH-520 por el mismo problema: los rodamientos de la rueda de corte se desgastan muy rápido y la correa empieza a chirriar y a deslizarse después de pocas horas de uso. Ya son seis unidades devueltas, y hemos tenido que reembolsar a dos de nuestros clientes.

Quisiéramos saber si ustedes tienen conocimiento de este problema en otros distribuidores, y cómo debemos proceder con las unidades devueltas. También nos gustaría saber si pueden enviarnos repuestos o si debemos devolverles las máquinas. Quedamos atentos a su respuesta.

Atentamente,
Roberto Valdivia
Gerente de Flota, Alquileres Sierra Verde

body:
I'm the guy at the parts counter at Mason Lake Equipment, and I'm tired of calling about this. We have now had three customers come in with a burst high-pressure hose on their FH-P90. One of them is a contractor who got a nasty cut on his forearm when it let go, and he's talking about a lawyer. I've been polite for weeks and nobody from your side has called me back. I need someone with actual authority to contact me, not another canned reply. I need to know if this is a known defect, whether you plan to inspect or replace the hoses, and what I'm supposed to tell people who walk in with a hose in one hand and their phone in the other. I have eight more P90s in stock that I won't sell until I get answers. My number is 555-0187, ask for Jerry.

Jerry Mallory, Parts Counter, Mason Lake Equipment

body:

The replacement pump seal kit and high-pressure hose that we ordered for the FH-P90 under order FE-124456 arrived with the hose fitting cracked and the seal kit the wrong size. Sincerely,
Charles Whitby
Owner, Whitby Hardware

body:

Two won't hold power on the outlets, two shut off after a few minutes, and one has a pull cord that jammed on day one. We've held off on selling any of them since we obviously can't pass these along. What's the best way to get these credited or have them picked up? I don't mind a call, but email is easier since I'm out in the field half the week. I can send serial numbers and photos for every one of them if that helps. Appreciate your help sorting this out, and thanks for always being easy to deal with!

Stacy Nwosu, Operations Manager, Evergreen Lawn & Landscape

body:
Hello,

Our service department unpacked and inspected eight FH-340 chippers from the shipment received on the 3rd. Five of the eight show a defect at the same location. The weld that joins the discharge chute to the main housing is cracked or incomplete. The serial numbers on those units are in the range FH340-24-03112 to FH340-24-03119. We have not put any of these into service and have stopped them from going out to customers. Please advise on how you want us to document and report the issue, and whether you will arrange a replacement or repair. We can supply photographs, torque readings of the bolts, and the packing slip on request.

Regards,
Steven Pakula
Service Manager, Pakula Power Equipment

Accounts Payable, Larkspur Equipment Dealers
